title: Reconcile beads-worker-6 merge reds: 44 failing tests from combining branch quarantine lineage with main's impl migration
description: Discovered during i72x.6.a (merge of main 5324d4d4ed into beads-worker-6). Both parents green; the merge is the first time these lineages combined. Failing tests (worker6 checkout, python venv): tests/test_vectors.py test_every_dao_origin_vector_executes_production_validator_and_manager (32) + test_dao_origin_production_enforces_canonical_source_vectors (1); test_yggdrasil_derivation_vector (6, includes binding_invariant asserts addr.packed[8:16]==iid — the REJECTED native IID-equality invariant per spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing); test_x25519_key_derivation_vector (3); test_vector_file_schema[density_adaptive.json] (1, missing corpus file — pre-existing on BOTH parents); tests/rpl/test_root_signature.py (1). Mechanism: beads-worker-6 carried quarantine-era test files (test_vectors.py 14-line divergence, x25519.json, gcp3_trust_models.json — commits 30bad19aff, 7b5196b8b9) while main (9fceaf5406, 5c9f7ef657) migrated production Python/Rust derivations to upstream AddrForKey; the older test expectations now assert native-profile semantics against upstream production. NOT a regression from i72x.6.a's reference-module/corpus work (root-dio corpus tests green: 13 passed, 26 xpassed; failing tests do not consume reference_schnorr48). Resolution direction: adopt main's test-file/vector versions where branch quarantine tests encode the rejected invariant (never weaken to green; align with upstream oracle yggdrasil_address.json + production); itemized red list preserved at merge time in bead comments. Reconcile before next sync-to-main.
